title: "Secret Realm Opens"
next_chapter_hook: "Just as the three were preparing to venture deeper, a call that only Chen Ji could perceive echoed from the depths of the secret realm—that aura was identical to the Tianji Record Fragment, as if guiding him toward some forgotten forbidden land."

text.content: "Before Chen Ji could fully absorb that fateful prophecy, the sky above the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate tore open with a blood-colored fissure—a celestial phenomenon that only appears when a Transcendent Deity Realm expert strikes with full force. Deep within the fissure, a suspended palace complex could be faintly seen, shrouded in mist and emanating an ancient, desolate aura—the legendary entrance to the ancient secret realm. Everyone's gaze was drawn to that fissure, but Chen Ji noticed more—the fragmented soul of Mo Xiansheng trembled slightly within the Tianji Record, its frequency resonating with the fragment he had obtained."

dialogue.content: "'The time has come.' Mo Xiansheng's voice was aged and weary. 'A second page of the Tianji Fragment lies hidden within the realm, but you must remember—the first three layers of trials will sever your connection with me. Before that, ask everything you need to know.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji took a deep breath. Mo Xiansheng had finally agreed to tell him about the second page's clues, but he only had half an hour to prepare. In the distance, cultivators from various sects had already begun gathering at the secret realm entrance. The sky was filled with flowing light and brilliant colors, with countless flying artifacts cutting through the air. He needed to make a choice—blend in quietly with the group, or seize the initiative in the chaos?"

choice.prompt: "Facing the opening of the secret realm, how should Chen Ji act?"

choices.description: "Officially debut as a core disciple of the Tianqing Sect, establishing his presence before all factions and deterring potential opponents."
choices.visible_reward: "Reputation +15, obtain priority selection rights within the secret realm"
choices.risk_hint: "Will become a target for all, facing more challenges"

text.content: "Chen Ji straightened his robes and strode confidently toward the sect assembly point. His appearance caused a stir—the waste of a disciple actually attending as a core disciple? The elders of the Tianqing Sect's expressions shifted subtly, but no one stepped forward to stop him."

choices.description: "Hide his identity among ordinary disciples, using the Tianji Record to secretly observe all factions, seeking exploitable weaknesses and opportunities."

text.content: "Chen Ji quietly retreated to the back of the crowd, circulating his profound arts to conceal his aura. He quickly disappeared among the ordinary disciples, with no one noticing that unremarkable figure taking in the entire battlefield."

choices.description: "Proactively challenge potential threats, establishing credibility through absolute strength and碾压, ensuring no one dares to despise."
choices.risk_hint: "May expose some strength, attracting attention from stronger beings"

text.content: "A slight smile curved Chen Ji's lips as he strode toward the most arrogant provocateur at the center. That person was loudly mocking how no one from Tianqing Sect dared to respond. The next moment, Chen Ji's sword intent had locked onto his brow center—within three breaths, victory was decided."

"The secret realm's entrance floated high in the sky, the blood-colored fissure like a giant eye opening wide. At its center, a brilliant pillar of light shot straight down. Dozens of elite disciples from various sects had already gathered around the pillar, each radiating impressive auras. The tense atmosphere was palpable. From Mo Xiansheng, Chen Ji learned that the first three layers of the realm would suppress his Heavenly Secrets abilities. He needed to find his bearings quickly on the first layer."

dialogue.content: "'Senior Sister Su, Chen Nian, stay close to me once inside the realm.' Chen Ji lowered his voice, his gaze sweeping across the crowd from Xuanwu Sect. 'That Han Lie has been watching us.'"

"Su Qingyao slightly furrowed her brow, following Chen Ji's gaze. Han Lie was precisely the number one genius of the Xuanwu Sect, rumored to have broken through to the late Golden Core stage, his strength unfathomable. 'Why is he targeting our Tianqing Sect?'"

"Chen Nian whispered, 'I heard people from Xuanwu Sect earlier saying someone from their ranks declared they would give Tianqing Sect a "surprise" inside the realm.' She paused. 'It seems to be aimed at you, Senior Brother.'"

text.content: "A cold smile flickered in Chen Ji's heart. Perfect—he had been worried about lacking an opportunity to establish his prestige. The secret realm was filled with dangers; if someone came to deliver themselves on a platter, he wouldn't mind harvesting another share of fate. But this wasn't the time to act yet. The spatial fluctuations at the realm entrance grew increasingly intense, the light pillar slowly expanding—its opening was imminent."

choice.prompt: "The secret realm entrance is about to open. Facing possible provocation from Han Lie, how should Chen Ji respond?"

choices.description: "Deliberately display weakness, causing Han Lie to relax his guard. Wait until he enters the realm's depths, then strike—letting him taste defeat at the moment he most craves success."
choices.visible_reward: "Strategy +15, Han Lie exposes weaknesses after entering the realm"
choices.risk_hint: "Requires extreme patience, may affect allied morale"

text.content: "Chen Ji deliberately suppressed his aura to the early Foundation Building stage, hunching his back, appearing even more worthless than usual. Upon seeing this, Han Lie indeed revealed a contemptuous smile and turned to provoke other targets."

choices.description: "Engage Han Lie head-on before everyone, defeating him with absolute strength and utterly crushing Xuanwu Sect's arrogance."
choices.visible_reward: "Reputation +20, all sects gain newfound respect for Tianqing Sect"
choices.risk_hint: "May provoke revenge from forces behind Han Lie"

text.content: "Chen Ji strode forward proudly, his imposing aura suddenly released. The aura of early Golden Core cultivation swept across the entire area. Han Lie's pupils contracted sharply—had this waste been hiding his true abilities all along?"

choices.description: "Incite conflict between other sects and Han Lie, letting them exhaust each other inside the realm while you reap the fisherman's gains."
choices.risk_hint: "Many variables, may spiral out of control"

text.content: "Chen Ji quietly sent a meaningful glance toward Ye Qing of the Holy Sect beside him. The latter understood immediately, and moments later someone deliberately mentioned Xuanwu Sect's recent scandals before Han Lie."

"Just as all factions were at daggers drawn, the blood-colored fissure in the sky suddenly expanded tenfold. A vast, primordial aura poured down from the light pillar, and the secret realm entrance fully opened. Elders from all sects simultaneously出手 to stabilize the spatial passage. Countless figures transformed into streams of light rushing toward the entrance. Chen Ji felt a mysterious force pulling at his soul—that was the realm itself selecting who may enter."

dialogue.content: "'Are you ready?' Chen Ji gripped his sword hilt, glancing back at Su Qingyao and Chen Nian for a final time. 'Once inside the realm, follow my orders. Don't ask why.'"

"Su Qingyao slightly nodded, a complex glint flickering in her eyes. This worthless junior brother was becoming increasingly unfathomable to her, but for some reason, she chose to trust him. 'Alright.'"

text.content: "The moment the three stepped into the light pillar, the world spun. Countless images flashed before Chen Ji's eyes like a revolving lantern—those were the Tianji Record Fragment resonating with something in the realm, seemingly guiding him toward a certain direction. But at the same time, his Heavenly Fate Value was rapidly depleting. The Tianji Record's warning exploded in his mind: the first layer's trial is the 'Mental Demon Space,' which would manifest the fears that haunt the entrant through illusions."

"When Chen Ji opened his eyes again, he found himself standing alone in a gray space. Nothing existed in all directions except endless mist. Su Qingyao and Chen Nian were nowhere to be found, and the connection with the Tianji Record and Mo Xiansheng had been completely severed. His heart sank—this was expected; the first three layers would deny him any external assistance. Here, he could only rely on himself."

choice.prompt: "Alone trapped in the Mental Demon Space, how should Chen Ji respond?"

choices.description: "Expend 5 Heavenly Fate Value to forcibly glimpse three hours into the future, finding the correct direction within the illusions."
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain clear directional guidance, avoid lethal traps"
choices.risk_hint: "Heavenly Fate is extremely precious; every point concerns life and death."
choices.process_label: 陈机决定冒险使用天机能力

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji gritted his teeth and activated the Tianji Record. A blurry image emerged in his mind—a faint light point to the northeast, that should be the exit. But another figure seemed to appear in the image as well—Su Qingyao, trapped somewhere."

text.content: "He took a deep breath and made his decision—rescue Su Qingyao first, then find the exit. The rules of Mental Demon Space weren't yet clear, but Su Qingyao's safety could not be risked."

choices.description: "Rely on one's own strength to forcibly tear apart the illusionary space, breaking through the Mental Demon Space's bonds with pure cultivation."
choices.risk_hint: "May attract attention from the realm's guardians"

text.content: "Spiritual energy surged around Chen Ji as he executed the Tianqing Sect's secret sword technique. A brilliant sword light cleaved through the gray void, and the illusionary space began to shatter like a broken mirror. He faintly sensed several gazes secretly observing his true combat power."

choices.description: "Proactively accept the Mental Demon illusion's trial, using information seen in the illusions to analyze the realm's essence and patterns."
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain crucial intelligence, understand Mental Demon Space's operating rules"

text.content: "Chen Ji did not resist; instead, he closed his eyes and let the illusions encroach. A blurry image emerged—he saw a past scene of himself, witnessing that youth deemed worthless take step after step through mockery to where he stands today."

"In the same moment Chen Ji made his choice, Su Qingyao and Chen Nian were also struggling within their own Mental Demon Spaces. Su Qingyao's illusion was the Chen Ji she could never fully comprehend—he stood atop a high platform gazing down at all living beings, while she was merely a spectator looking up from below. Chen Nian saw a closed door, and familiar voices seemed to call her name from behind it."

dialogue.content: "'No... this isn't real.' Su Qingyao struggled within the illusion, yet found herself unable to approach that figure standing on the platform no matter what. Suddenly she realized something—the real Chen Ji would never make her only look up. He would extend his hand."

text.content: "When Chen Ji found Su Qingyao, she sat quietly with closed eyes, surrounded by faint spiritual light, seemingly in some state of enlightenment. He did not disturb her, merely standing guard nearby. After a moment, Su Qingyao opened her eyes, her gaze carrying an unusual brilliance. 'I saw you,' she softly said. 'The real you.'"

"Chen Ji's heart stirred, but his expression remained unchanged. 'The Mental Demon trial tests obsession; each of us has our own obstacles to overcome.' He turned to look at the exit's glow gradually materializing ahead. 'Let's go. The real trial still lies ahead.' The three figures stepped into the light, unaware that atop an ancient altar deep within the realm, a pair of eyes was watching them through layers of void—the realm's own will examining these uninvited guests."

"After passing through the Mental Demon Space, the three finally arrived at the true world of the realm's first layer. This was an expanse of ancient battlefield ruins; among broken walls and ruins, ancient runes left by primordial cultivators could be faintly seen. Su Qingyao and Chen Nian exchanged glances, both seeing tacit understanding in each other's eyes—they had seemingly glimpsed each other's figures within the illusions, forming an unusual connection."

dialogue.content: "'Senior Brother, I saw Senior Sister Su in my illusion,' Chen Nian whispered. 'She stood behind you, as if guarding something for you.' She paused. 'She appeared in my illusion as well.'"
"Su Qingyao slightly furrowed her brow, looking at Chen Ji. 'What about you? What did you see in your illusion?' She noticed Chen Ji's expression when he emerged, seemingly more exhausted than them."

text.content: "Chen Ji did not answer, merely directing his gaze toward the depths of the ancient battlefield. Mo Xiansheng had said the second page of the Tianji Fragment lay hidden somewhere in the realm. At this moment, he faintly sensed an aura from that direction—originating from the same source as the Tianji Record Fragment, but far more concentrated. Something seemed hidden there. But he also sensed another force approaching—Han Lie's team, they had also broken through the Mental Demon Space."

dialogue.content: "'Here they come.' Chen Ji's lips curved slightly as he turned toward the path they had traveled. 'It seems our friends from Xuanwu Sect don't intend to let us enjoy this fortune alone.' Su Qingyao and Chen Nian immediately assumed combat readiness, the three forming a triangular formation back-to-back."

text.content: "In the distance, seven or eight figures emerged from the mist. Leading them was Han Lie, followed by elite disciples from Xuanwu Sect, each radiating profound auras. Upon seeing Chen Ji and his companions had arrived first, a flash of surprise and irritation crossed Han Lie's eyes. 'Wastes are wastes—even finding their way is just taking shortcuts.' He coldly laughed,丝毫不掩饰 his hostility. 'Hand over whatever fortune you just obtained, and I'll spare your lives.'"

"Chen Ji lightly laughed; that smile made Han Lie feel inexplicably uneasy. 'Senior Brother Han,' he said unhurriedly, 'what did you see in the Mental Demon Space just now?' Han Lie's expression changed drastically—that was his greatest secret. 'You...' Chen Ji continued: 'Let me guess. Failure? Failure again and again?' He stepped forward, his aura beginning to rise. 'Coincidentally, I had a similar illusion. So—'"

dialogue.content: "'—I understand your desire to prove yourself very well.' Chen Ji's voice suddenly turned cold. 'But you chose the wrong target.' Before the words even finished, a sword light had already shot from Su Qingyao's hand, striking directly at the disciple nearest to Han Lie. Su Qingyao and Chen Ji's coordination was seamless—she was responsible for pincering, Chen Ji for the main attack, and Chen Nian sought weaknesses on the flank."

text.content: "Battle erupted in an instant. The Xuanwu Sect disciples had numerical superiority, but Chen Ji and his companions coordinated flawlessly. Su Qingyao's sword technique was sharp and precise, tearing a gap in the enemy's formation; Chen Nian, though weakest in cultivation, had bizarre movement skills, specializing in attacking vital points; Chen Ji held the center, each sword strike bringing someone down. The three's performance was entirely unlike what ordinary disciples should possess, especially Chen Ji—his displayed combat power far exceeded the rumored waste image."

"Han Lie finally realized something was wrong. This worthless Chen Ji was not some Foundation Building stage waste at all, but a master who had concealed his abilities deeply. But it was too late—half his subordinates had already fallen, and he himself had been driven into a corner by Chen Ji. 'You... you've been hiding your true abilities all along!' Han Lie roared."

dialogue.content: "'Hiding my abilities?' Chen Ji lightly laughed, the tip of his sword three inches from Han Lie's throat. 'Senior Brother Han, you're wrong. I simply... excel at letting others believe I'm something.' His gaze was ice-cold. 'Now, tell me—what did you see in your illusion?' Han Lie's pupils contracted; that was bone-deep fear. He had seen—himself being pierced through the heart by this waste in a single sword strike."

text.content: "Just then, the ground at the center of the battlefield suddenly quivered. A brilliant pillar of light erupted from the earth, blasting everyone back several steps. Within the pillar, an ancient altar could be faintly seen, and atop it floated a scroll emanating pale golden light—an ancient text radiating the aura of the Tianji Record! Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The second page of the Fragment had actually appeared before everyone's eyes."

"All gazes were drawn to that scroll. Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record Fragment within him trembling violently—a resonance of shared origin. But at the same time, he sensed a terrifying aura awakening from the depths of the altar—the guardian protecting the Fragment had been alarmed. Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in his mind: 'The second page... finally found. But be careful—the guardian will not easily let anyone take it.'"

"Han Lie took the opportunity to retreat several steps, a glint of greed flickering across his face. 'That's... the Tianji Fragment!' He had clearly sensed the extraordinary nature of that scroll, his eyes burning with fervent desire. Xuanwu Sect had intricate connections with the legends of the Tianji Record—if he could obtain this page..."

"The light pillar gradually dissipated, and the scroll atop the altar was fully revealed. Within the golden radiance, countless ancient runes flowed between the pages, as if containing the deepest mysteries of heaven and earth. Chen Ji's heart pounded violently—he had waited too long for this moment. But the guardian protecting the Fragment was awakening; terrifying pressure bore down like a physical force, and no one dared act rashly."
